analyzeDialog.gitCommitInvalid: Commit must be a hexadecimal SHA of 7 to 64 characters.
analyzeDialog.gitTokenHelper: Used to reach the repository. Never stored.
analyzeDialog.gitAllLanguages: Git repositories are analyzed in every supported language.
analyzeDialog.gitAlreadyAdded: This repository is already in your projects.
analyzeDialog.gitUnresolved: Repository not found, or that branch or commit does not exist. Check the URL and, for a private repository, the access token.

analyzeDialog.dropzoneText: Drag and drop a .zip file or click to browse

editRepoDialog.title: Edit Project
editRepoDialog.subtitle: Change the name and color of your project
editRepoDialog.saveFailed: Failed to save. Please try again.
editRepoDialog.deleteWarning: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? It will be permanently removed from your projects.
editRepoDialog.deleteFailed: Failed to delete. Please try again.

project.analysisRunningText: Your repository is currently being analyzed. This process may include parsing files, building graphs, and generating summaries. The status is refreshed automatically.
project.analysisFailedText: The last run did not finish. Retrying starts a fresh attempt beside it — the documentation, graphs and chats you already have are kept.
project.noRunText: Nothing has run for this repository yet, so there is no documentation to show. Starting an analysis dispatches one.
project.staleText: This documentation was produced by an older version of the analyzer. Relaunching analyzes the repository again at the current version, and this analysis stays available.

relaunchDialog.title: Relaunch analysis
relaunchDialog.explainStale: This repository will be analyzed again at the analyzer's current version.
relaunchDialog.explainFailed: The run that failed will be retried at the analyzer's current version.
relaunchDialog.explainNever: No analysis has run for this repository yet. This starts one at the analyzer's current version.
relaunchDialog.explainStuck: If the run is still going, nothing here will disturb it. If it stopped without reporting back, this settles it and starts a new attempt.
relaunchDialog.keepsExisting: Nothing is replaced: this project keeps its documentation, graphs, chat threads and deep analyses.
relaunchDialog.tokenHelper: Needed for a private remote, because relaunching fetches the repository again. Used to reach it, never stored.
relaunchDialog.nothingToDo: Nothing to relaunch: this analysis is already at the current version, or a run is already in progress.
relaunchDialog.unresolved: The repository could not be reached. Check that it still exists and, if it is private, that the token grants access to it.
relaunchDialog.unreachable: Could not reach the git remote. Try again in a moment.
relaunchDialog.failed: The relaunch could not be started. Please try again.

import.loadingText: We're setting up the shared project for you. This will only take a moment.
import.errorText: We couldn't import this project. The link may be invalid or the project may no longer be available.

analysis.deepAnalysisQueryLabel: What would you like to analyze?

analysis.deepAnalysisEmptyDesc: Start a deep analysis to get detailed reports about your codebase.
